c-web-6.embed:
Password reset check (PHP):
  if (md5($_POST['token']) == "0e830400451993494058024219903391") { echo $flag; }

Both this stored value and certain md5 outputs have the form 0e followed by only
digits -- PHP's == treats each as the number 0, so they compare equal without matching.
Find a token whose md5 is also a "0e[0-9]+" string.

(When the loose comparison passes, the server prints: unpatched{lo0se_c0mpar3_magic_hash})
